messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-edge-lb (high error rate) — PD#INC-91234. auto-escalation initiated :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Symptoms: TLS handshake failures (ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR) and ALB target group showing >80% unhealthy. A subset of regions (us-east-1) reporting spikes in 502/524. See alert: https://pagerduty.example/INC-91234
alex: acked oncall. I'm digging in. quick question — is there any recent infra change?
priya: I saw a config change for an A record TTL change targeting the new edge pool around 03:12 UTC, but deployment notes said gradual roll.
alex: pulling LB target health now, running curl against edge vip and a direct target
alex: ```
# curl to edge vip
curl -v https://edge.redwood.example/health || true
* TLSv1.2 (AFTER)
* SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to edge.redwood.example:443
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
kevin: i'm on PD secondary; enroute. Do we have Cloud provider incident?
priya: I checked Cloud provider console — no global outage, but target registration flapped after the DNS reweight. Health checks started returning 503 from backend app (nginx) — logs show backend returning 502s when SNI mismatch occurs.
alex: looking at ALB logs — lots of `TLS handshake error: ssl3_get_server_certificate:certificate verify failed` and `no shared cipher` entries around 03:14-03:18 UTC. That aligns with the A-record switchover.
support-bot: There are ~1,100 failing requests/minute for customers on the affected edge pool. Support queue: ~45 tickets flagged P1.
alex: mitigation plan: 1) pause DNS reweight / revert A record to old edge pool (rollback TTL low), 2) re-register healthy targets into LB target group, 3) temporarily increase health check timeout and mark critical routes to fallback region.
kevin: I'm going to trigger PD escalation to network-oncall and infra-sre, and I'll start the DNS rollback. alex — can you prepare the target group reconcile?
alex: on it. running registration script now: ```
aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --targets Id=i-0abc123,Id=i-0def456
```
priya: also flipping ALB listener config to ensure TLS protocols include TLS1.2 and a wider cipher set while we verify certificates. prepping a patched listener diff.
incident-bot: PD ack timestamped by alex at 03:21 UTC. Escalation: network-oncall paged.
kevin: DNS rollback issued (change pushed) — propagated to most resolvers (TTL obeyed). Monitoring propagation: `dig +short @8.8.8.8 edge.redwood.example A` now returns previous IPs.
alex: target re-register completed; health checks ramping back to healthy for two-thirds of targets. Observability shows 50% reduction in 502s.
priya: rolling back the listener cipher lock prematurely introduced in the recent config. temporary allowlist applied.
support-bot: customer-impact summary (initial): ~15% of API traffic experienced increased error rates for ~18 minutes in us-east-1. Top affected customers: 4 enterprise tenants with heavy east-coast traffic. Support is sending status updates.
kevin: PD closed the high-priority page after we saw stabilized health at 03:36 UTC. leaving thread open for post-incident notes and RCA.
alex: follow-ups: - postmortem owner: alex - timeline + logs to be posted in #postmortems - infra ticket INF-2048 created for listener config validation and safer rollout gating - ops runbook update: add DNS reweight rollback checklist and preflight checks for SNI/ciphers.
priya: noted — I'll own the listener config validation and add automated integ tests simulating SNI mismatch.
kevin: thanks all. tagging incident-bot to create a postmortem stub: `incident-bot create-postmortem INC-91234`
incident-bot: Postmortem stub created at https://redwoodpostmortems/INC-91234 — assigned to alex.
alex: quick retrospective: root cause appears to be an aggressive DNS reweight plus a listener crypto-policy change that wasn't validated against the older edge hosts. mitigation combo: rollback + target re-registration + widening TLS policy. We'll include a preflight matrix for next rollout. :thumbsup:
priya: closing the ticket on listener rollout today. will sync with security for approved cipher list.
kevin: final note — set a watch for 24h to ensure no regression. If anything flares, escalate immediately.
support-bot: I'll update customers with timeline + mitigation summary and reference INC-91234.
alex: thread closed for live mitigation; keeping channel for postmortem discussion.
